item-handbooktext-woundcure-leg: A treated poultice for leg injuries. It also lowers one random death-touched leg wound by one tier each use.
item-handbooktext-woundcure-torso: A treated poultice for torso injuries. It also lowers one random death-touched torso wound by one tier each use.
itemdesc-woundcure-leg: A treated poultice for leg wounds.
itemdesc-woundcure-torso: A treated poultice for torso wounds.
deathwounds:gui-wounds-empty: No lasting death wounds. Dying in survival can add movement or hunger penalties until treated with the matching poultice.
deathwounds:debuff-wound-move-desc: Your body does not move as it once did—muscles protest every step. Rumor speaks of a special remedy that can set this right.
deathwounds:debuff-wound-hunger-desc: Since your last brush with death, meals never seem to last—the body asks for fuel again sooner. A healer's poultice for the torso may yet calm this.
deathwounds:deathdebuff-respawn-bodywarn: Your body feels badly battered—as if something important was torn and did not come back the same. Open Character → the Death Wounds panel beside this dialog and read your injuries. A cure is possible, if you can find the right poultice.
deathwounds:woundcure-heal-chat: Curing that wound makes you feel better.
deathwounds:woundcure-nothing-to-cure: You have no injury in that part of the body to treat with this tincture.
